Their contact turns interpretation from receiving an isolated hidden proposition into a method that notices a mark, follows an ordered account, and returns it to a consequential whole.

findings.containment: The ordinary promise of teaching the interpretation of reports remains intact. This is a qualified pericope reading limited to the supplied 12:1 and 12:3 contacts; the live narrower reading centered on dream interpretation remains available.
